slides.texte_overlay:
5 posture habits that make you
look weak in public
1: shrinking into the corner of a sofa. Curling up at a party makes you look like you want to disappear. Sit in the middle, back straight, arms relaxed.
2: shuffling your feet when you walk. Dragging steps look tired and unsure. Lift your feet, take full strides, and let your heels land first.
3: hugging your own arms. Wrapping your arms around yourself looks cold and anxious. Keep your arms loose at your sides or rest one hand in a pocket.
4: tilting your head down to your phone in conversation. Even a quick check shrinks your posture. Put the phone away and keep your chin level.
5: hiding behind your hair or cap. Pulling a cap low or hiding your eyes blocks connection. Let people see your face and your expressions.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. A calmer, more curious mind shows up in how you stand and move.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. A calmer, more curious mind shows in how you stand and move.

slides.texte_overlay: The fix: imagine a thread pulling the top of your head upward. Use it whenever you walk into a room. Your spine, shoulders and chin follow on their own.
